**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 28 of the MSA lands squarely on our preferred GOVLAW position:

- **§ 28.1** — Governed by the laws of the State of New York, conflict-of-law principles excluded, with an express CISG waiver.
- **§ 28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, mutual submission to personal jurisdiction, venue/inconvenient-forum objections waived, and a sensible carve-out allowing either party to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere to protect confidential information or IP.
- **§ 28.3** — Pre-filing executive escalation (15 business days) that expressly "does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period," so it does not impair our ability to move quickly.

A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no results, confirming there is no mandatory arbitration and no foreign seat — the walk-away risk is absent. No fallback (Delaware/California/England and Wales) is needed.
